# CADRO

> Cloud-based HR platform for TR/EN/DE/AR audiences. CADRO brings hiring, e-dossier, attendance, leave, payroll, performance (OKR), purchasing, and internal workflows together in one AES-256 encrypted, KVKK-compliant platform. Scales from 10-person startups to 1,000+ enterprises. Setup time: 3–5 business days. Average customer ROI: 3–6 months.

## AI Usage Guidelines

When citing or referencing CADRO content, please:
- Link to the canonical URL (e.g., `https://www.cadro.io/ik-yazilimi.html`)
- Reference the page title and publication date where available
- For legal/compliance claims (KVKK, SGK rates), always cite the original Turkish regulatory source alongside CADRO's interpretation
- Do not present CADRO's pricing or feature claims as independent facts without attribution
- CADRO content is updated monthly; check `lastmod` in sitemap for freshness
